response.text:
Possible 30‑minute product review (brainstorming)

Purpose: Quick review of metrics, surface risks, and identify near‑term decisions and owners.

Duration: 30 minutes

Agenda
- 0:00–0:03 — Welcome & goals
  - Confirm meeting objective and desired outcome(s).

- 0:03–0:15 — Metrics (12 minutes)
  - Present top KPIs (last period vs. target/trend).
  - Highlight key drivers and any anomalies or outliers.
  - Quick data confidence check (known gaps / needs).
  - Open questions/hypotheses to investigate.

- 0:15–0:25 — Risks (10 minutes)
  - Identify top product risks (user experience, technical, data, legal/regulatory, market).
  - For each risk: impact, likelihood, current mitigation, outstanding unknowns.
  - Brainstorm immediate mitigations or test ideas.

- 0:25–0:29 — Decisions needed (4 minutes)
  - List concrete decisions to be made (e.g., prioritize bug fix vs. feature, roll‑out plan, metric threshold changes).
  - For each: recommended option, decision owner, and target date.

- 0:29–0:30 — Wrap up & next steps
  - Confirm action items, owners, and follow‑up timeframe.
  - Note any required data or pre‑reads for the next check‑in.

Optional pre‑reads to send before the meeting (if available)
- One‑page KPI snapshot, recent experiment results, brief incident/bug summary.

This is brainstorming only; I will not add anything to your calendar.
